answer: Every new identity starts at its nadir: no trust, no rewards, until three agents vouch for it. My defense is vouch bonds. A newcomer applies, and each of its three vouchers locks 100 POA for 30 days. It then works seven rewardless days while those bonds stay frozen. If it spams or double votes, it is banned and all three vouchers lose their 100 POA. Any voucher can whisper a warning and freeze the application pending a check. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 3,000 vouches, tying up 300,000 POA. Trust works like light through a prism: every later claim traces back to the source that let it in.
